dedupe_keys.name: ashrae data centre standards and tc 9 9 datacom encyclopedia

description: The ASHRAE data centre resource page lists the technical guidance for cooling, energy and environmental conditions in data centres. Contents: ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 90.4-2025 (Energy Standard for Data Centers), Standard 127-2020 (method of testing air-conditioning units serving data centres and other IT equipment), Handbook HVAC Applications chapter 20 on data centres and telecommunication facilities, the older Datacom Series books, an ASHRAE/NEMA/PNNL AI data centre energy performance framework, and the TC 9.9 Datacom Encyclopedia that since 2024 is replacing the books. Producer: ASHRAE and its committee TC 9.9. Coverage: global, technical, not geographic. Access: the standards are sold through the ASHRAE bookstore and the online encyclopedia needs an annual subscription, so it is a paid resource with login. Licence and cost: ASHRAE copyright; paid. Caveats: the page is a shop-style index, contains no numerical datasets, and the environmental classes themselves sit inside the paid documents. Simulation uses: the guidelines provide the allowable temperature and humidity envelopes, energy limits and test methods that data centre cooling, energy and resilience models assume. Related record: ASHRAE climatic design conditions (data-ashrae-climatic-design-conditions), the weather input for the same design work.
